review_status: Reviewed before inference by author agent and independent root agent; not human-reviewed.

projection.source: Raw captured record embedded per case; SHA256 of original source file, line bytes excluding LF, and canonical record.
projection.retained_context: Before-call context is explicitly labelled and must not be treated as post-call held state.
projection.request_origin: Authored reconstruction from captured operation arguments. Historical user wording was not available.
projection.selection: Five episodes selected before new inference to cover unverified placement, air grasp, pre-lift and place safety rejection, and successful/failed reset. Paired placement/reset records are dependent.
